groups.libraryHint: Your reusable skills. Turning one on copies it into this app.
groups.appHint: Skills that live only in this app, such as the ones its template came with.

toasts.turnedOn: Turned on “{{title}}”. Saved to this app.
toasts.turnedOff: Turned off “{{title}}”. Saved to this app.

view.title: Skills
view.subtitle: Guidance Copilot follows while it builds this app
view.newSkillTitle: Write or upload your own skill

deleteDialog.title: Delete custom skill?
deleteDialog.message: Delete “{{title}}” from your skill library? Apps that already use it keep their copy. This only removes it from your reusable library.

removeDialog.title: Remove skill from this app?
removeDialog.message: Copilot stops using “{{title}}” in this app. It isn’t in your skill library, so to get it back you’d restore it from History.
removeDialog.messageSaveFirst: Copilot stops using “{{title}}” in this app. It isn’t in your skill library, so to get it back you’d restore it from History. Save it to your library first if you want to reuse it.

inspector.label: {{title}} details
inspector.managedNote: Rayfin manages this skill. It’s always on and updates with the Rayfin CLI.
inspector.appNote: This skill lives only in this app. Save it to your library to use it in other apps.
inspector.appNoteLocked: This skill lives only in this app. It can’t be saved to your library under its current name.
inspector.useOn: Copilot follows it from your next message.
inspector.useOff: Adds it to this app. Every change is saved in History.
inspector.newer: A newer version of this skill is available.
inspector.noTriggers: Copilot decides from the skill’s instructions.
inspector.notInstalled: Added to this app when you turn the skill on.

overview.label: About skills
overview.how1: Turn a skill on. Fabricator adds its instructions to this app and saves the change in History.
overview.how2: When a request matches the skill, Copilot reads it and follows its guidance.
overview.how3: Turn it off at any time. Select a skill to see what it teaches.
overview.updatesText_one: A built-in skill in this app has a newer version.
overview.updatesText_other: {{count}} built-in skills in this app have a newer version.
overview.ownText: Select New skill to write one for your brand, your data’s vocabulary or your team’s review checklist, or to upload a skill you already have.

custom.libraryHint: Also keep it in your library so you can reuse it in other apps.
custom.descriptionPlaceholder: One line shown on the skill card
custom.hint: The frontmatter description tells the agent when to use this skill; the body is the guidance it follows.
custom.reviewHint: Review the skill, then add it to this app.
custom.uploadLead: Upload a skill you already have to preview it, then add it to this app. It needs a SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter; any references/ files come along too.
